column1: # Coordinate notations a search field reads, and near misses it refuses (T-0206).
# Tab-separated, one row per vector, no header row. The first column says what
#   refuse  <text>  <why it is not a coordinate>
# Read by two tests, never copied:
#   - `plugins/coordinates` parses every accept row and requires every refuse
#   - the app formats each accepted point with `plugins/share` in decimal, DMS
#     and DDM and parses the result back with `plugins/coordinates`, so the two
# The 18 accept rows are the notations: decimal with and without signs, the
# hemisphere letters as a prefix and as a suffix, symbols and plain spaces for
# DMS and DDM, lower case letters, letters attached to the number, negative
# zero, and a bare DMS pair where the comma alone separates the components.
# The refuse rows are the forms that must not become a coordinate row: three
# numbers, a minute or second at 60, an axis out of range, a longitude-first
# pair, a sign that contradicts its hemisphere, one component alone, and a bare
# integer pair that is as likely a house number.

column3: three numbers and no pair separator
a bare integer pair is as likely a house number
a bare integer pair with a comma is still a house number
one component is not a point
three components are not a pair
longitude first is refused, never swapped
two latitudes are not a point
the sign contradicts the north hemisphere
